Aisha: Quick sync — planning a staggered live demo for the webinar (US + EMEA) to avoid model overload. Need run-of-show with fallback cues. Key asks: confirm speaker windows, load test timing, and fallback model variants. :eyes:
Ben: Good call. What's our target throughput per demo? Need to size dedicated pool or bursts.
Carlos: For safety let's plan for 150 RPS peak per demo window. Fallback plan: failover to `rwd-latency-lite` or reduce max tokens to 128.
Dina: Speakers ok with staggered starts. Proposed slots: US West demo 10:00 PT, EMEA demo 17:00 CET. Can we do a 30m buffer between them?
Ethan: Yes — infra can reserve a dedicated pool 10:15–11:30 PT (US) and 17:00–18:30 CET (EMEA). I'll schedule a pre-run at 09:30 PT to ramp and validate KV cache warmup.
Fiona: Rehearsal checklist (short):
``` 
- 09:00 PT: tech check (audio + demo env)
- 09:30 PT: load ramp (script v1)
- 09:55 PT: smoke test + fallback toggle test
- 10:00 PT: US demo live (operator on standby)
- 10:30 PT: warm down + metric snapshot
``` 
Also: confirm fallback message copy for presenters.
Carlos: I'll implement traffic-shift script: route 100% -> primary; if GPU util > 90% or p95 latency > 200ms then toggle 70% -> `rwd-latency-lite` and reduce max tokens.
DeployBot: load-test scheduled: 2026-04-15T09:30:00Z (script: `webinar-ramp-v1`).
CalendarBot: Event created: "Staggered Webinar — Demo Windows" on 2026-04-15 with guests: speakers + ops.
Aisha: Thanks — action items: Carlos (traffic script + toggle), Ethan (reserve pools + metrics), Fiona (rehearsal checklist + fallback copy), Sam (intro + fallback lines for presenters). I'll confirm speaker availability and update run-of-show by EOD.
Sam: On it — rough draft of intro + fallback lines by 5pm PT. :+1:
